We also perform human evaluation based on the following three criteria: 1) Fluency indicates how well the metaphor is formed; 2) Consistency indicates whether the metaphor make sense; 3) Creativity scores how creative annotators think the metaphor is. Three annotators were instructed to rate the three criteria from 1 to 5.
Three annotators were instructed to rate the three criteria from 1 to 5, where 1 denotes worst and 5 be the best.
guideline: Annotators rated each generated metaphor on fluency, consistency, and creativity using a scale from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
Annotators rate Fluency, Consistency, and Creativity on a 1‑5 scale for each generated metaphor.

Fluency indicates how well the metaphor is formed; whether the expression is grammatical and fluent. Consistency indicates whether the metaphor make sense; how well the subject of the metaphor related to the object. Creativity scores how creative annotators think the metaphor is.
